mission_01: Use np.array() to create vectors from Python lists.
The magnitude of a vector is computed with np.linalg.norm(v).
Normalize by dividing the vector by its magnitude: v / np.linalg.norm(v).
The dot product uses np.dot(v, w) or v @ w.
The cross product uses np.cross(v, w) for 3D vectors.
The angle between vectors is arccos(dot_product / (norm_v * norm_w)).
